surface_value: Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) are readily available to our clients for all cleaning agents. Employees who handle chemicals are trained on the use and hazards of those chemicals. Accordingly, all cleaning agents will be used in a safe and proper manner and in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
